data_description.email: Email used to log in to the municipal payments portal
data_description.account_id: Utility account number in the consumption page URL, e.g. 14-6402-01
data_description.host: Tenant host portion of the portal URL, e.g. bastroptx.municipalonlinepayments.com
data_description.timezone: Local timezone of the utility (used to align hourly readings)
data_description.poll_interval: How often to fetch new readings (15-1440 minutes)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the municipal water portal. Please check your host and network connection.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your email and password.
error.invalid_account: The account ID was not found on this portal. Double check the number in the consumption page URL.
error.invalid_input: Invalid input provided. Please check all fields.
error.unknown: Unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs.

abort.already_configured: Municipal Water Usage integration is already configured for this account.
